WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR)
1.

Sri. Sudhirsingh R. Vijapur, learned DSGI is directed to take notice for respondent Nos.3 to 5.
2.

In this petition, the petitioner has sought for the following reliefs:
"(i) Issue a writ in the nature of the mandamus thereby directing the respondent nos.1 to 5 authorities to NC: 2024:KHC-K:9309 consider the representation by the petitioner vide annexure-f dated 07.12.2019, Annexure-G dated Gurunath vs The State Of Karnataka And Ors on 6 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6652092/
2 03.12.2020 and Annexure-H and H1 dated 20.09.2023 and Annexure-H2 and H3 dated 03.10.2023.
(ii) Respectively and to initiate acquisition proceedings or to pay the compensation amount as per prevailing market value in terms of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for the excess land having been utilized by the respondent authorities to the extent of 2 acres land, with all statutory benefits."
3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the respondents and perused the material on record.

entities.text: Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
4. It is the grievance of the petitioner that his representations dated 07.12.2019, 07.12.2019,
03.10.2023, 20.09.2023, 03.10.2023, 03.10.2023 at Annexure-F, G, H, H1, H2 and H3 submitted to the respondents has not been considered so far by them nor any order has been passed on the same.
Under these circumstances, the petitioner is before this Court by way of the present petition.
5. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondents submits that if reasonable time is given, they would consider and pass necessary order on the said representation.

In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances and rival submissions, the respondents are hereby directed to address the grievances of the petitioner and consider his representations dated 07.12.2019, 07.12.2019, 03.10.2023, 20.09.2023, 03.10.2023, 03.10.2023 at Annexure-F, G, H, H1,
H2 and H3 and pass appropriate order in accordance with law, within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
7.
With the aforesaid directions, the petition stands disposed of.
